verdict.rationale: Paperspace's own machine-creation docs say users choose a region when creating a machine, and machines come with persistent storage across multiple datacenter regions, so users can pick where machine data lives. Nothing documents formal data-residency guarantees or region control for Notebooks, shared drives, or Deployments storage. missing for 10: enumerated region list, explicit data-residency/compliance commitments, region selection for non-machine storage (notebooks, datasets, shared drives), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template, disk size, region, authentication, starting state
Paperspace's CPU machines are available in all Paperspace datacenter regions.
Machines are Linux and Windows virtual machines with persistent storage
